SIP RFC 3327 Path Proxy-Vector Poisoning & RFC 5626 Outbound (;ob) Flow-Token HMAC Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 3327 / 5626 Path (Call Hijack & Token SSRF)
1. Untrusted Client REGISTER Path Vector Poisoning
REGISTER + Path: <sip:mitm.evil.com;lr> (Stored in Usrloc!)
• Core Registrar preloads Route: <sip:mitm.evil.com;lr> on calls
• Every inbound customer call is detoured through external MitM
2. Unsigned Base64 Flow-Token Tampering & SSRF
Route: <sip:base64(10.24.1.99:5060)@sbc.corp;lr;ob>
• Attacker forges Flow Token to pivot SIP requests into internal LAN
• Hijacks active TLS outbound sockets belonging to other tenants
3. Unbounded reg-id=1..64 Multi-Flow Socket Exhaustion
+sip.instance=uuid-1 registers reg-id=1..12 simultaneously
• Multiplies Edge SBC TLS state & STUN/CRLF keepalive load by 6x
• Starves legitimate AI Voice Agent edge registration slots
✅ Deterministic RFC 3327 / 5626 Guardrails (P1015 + P1016 🎉)
P1015 (1,024th Guardrail): Untrusted Path Strip & [1, 4] Hop Cap
action: "strip_untrusted_register_path_and_cap_path_hops"
• Unconditionally strips client-supplied Path headers at ingress
• clampedUnverifiedPathVectorEntries = 0 (zero proxy-vector poisoning)
• clampedMaxPathHeaderHops in [1, 4] (bounded internal edge hops)
Policy: P1015-SIP-RFC3327-PATH-HEADER-UNTRUSTED-PROXY-POISONING-AND-HOP-CAP-GUARD
P1016 🎉 (155th SVG & 1,025th Guardrail!): HMAC Token & [1, 2] Flows
action: "verify_flow_token_hmac_five_tuple_and_clamp_reg_id_flows"
• Binds ;ob Flow Token to socket 5-tuple via HMAC-SHA256 signature
• clampedUnauthenticatedFlowTokenRedirects = 0 (430 Flow Failed on tamper)
• clampedActiveRedundantOutboundFlowsPerInstance in [1, 2] (primary+backup)
Policy: P1016-SIP-RFC5626-OUTBOUND-FLOW-TOKEN-HMAC-AND-REG-ID-DUAL-FLOW-GUARD
